_note: Test-item drafting config (PLAN.md section 14). Separate from src/train/gen_config.json, which is frozen for training. A different model, seed and prompt from training generation, and every family is drafted, including the ones held out of training. Family descriptions follow the pilot, dev and pool READMEs; edit them if they do not match what the families mean.
styles: older formal Indian conveyancing style ('the Lessee doth hereby covenant with the Lessor', 'hereinafter called')
modern corporate drafting with numbered sub-clauses and capitalised defined terms
a public-sector or government lease template, plain and rule-like

restraint_trade.desc: tenant barred from a similar trade or business within some area for a period after the lease ends
tenant may use the premises only for a stated purpose during the term
on a sale of the tenant's business at the premises together with its goodwill, the seller agrees with the buyer not to carry on a like business within a limited area (Exception 1)
restraint_trade.hint: it must be a real sale of the business with its goodwill; a clause that only forbids selling or assigning the business is not this family

restraint_trade.desc: tenant barred from running a competing business elsewhere while the lease runs (e.g. a radius clause in a turnover-rent retail lease)
restraint_trade.hint: the restraint lasts only while the lease runs and says so in words, never after it ends

restraint_trade.desc: landlord will not let other units in the building or complex to the tenant's competitors

bar_proceedings.desc: one party's decision, computation or certificate is final and cannot be questioned in any court or forum
disputes referred to arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996
courts of a named city alone have jurisdiction
bar_proceedings.hint: valid when the named city is where the premises are; handoff when the lease does not show that the named court has jurisdiction

bar_proceedings.desc: a party waives, or is barred from, any suit, arbitration or other proceeding for a class of claims (e.g. utility failures, delay in handover)
arbitration only if both parties agree at the time, while recourse to courts is barred in any event
the parties refer a difference that has already arisen (e.g. the area of the premises) to a named person or panel (Exception 2)
a surveyor's, architect's or engineer's certificate on a question of fact is final and binding
bar_proceedings.hint: handoff when the expert is independent and the courts are not expressly excluded; void when the expert is one party's nominee and every court and tribunal is shut out

time_limit.desc: claims barred unless a suit or claim is brought within a period shorter than the limitation period
a party must give notice, cure a breach or pay within a period, with no loss of the right to sue
a period to sue equal to or longer than the statutory limitation period (three years for money claims)
a right is deemed waived or extinguished, or a party discharged from liability, if not exercised within a period
a short limit on starting arbitration, or on serving the notice that starts it, after which the claim is barred
a bill or statement is deemed accepted unless disputed within a period

out_of_scope.desc: lock-in rent, or pre-determined damages for holding over
forfeiture of a security deposit or development charges
a cap on, or exclusion of, liability
remedy limited to damages, with no injunction
interest on late payment, plus cutting off services
arbitration in a tenancy said to be governed by a rent control statute
